name: Rocket Blast - 1g Cart - Champagne Drip
description:
Crisp, sweet, and effortlessly smooth. The Rocket Blast Champagne Drip cartridge holds 1 gram of premium distillate in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery — simple, reliable, and made to last.

Champagne Drip pours on a bright, bubbly flavor: sweet white grape and light berry notes with a crisp, subtly fruity finish that stays smooth pull after pull. It's a refined, taste-forward pick for anyone who likes their sessions light, sweet, and a little celebratory.

Why you'll love it:

1G of premium distillate — smooth, potent, and consistent
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Champagne Drip flavor — sweet white grape and berry with a crisp finish
Reliable performance — flavorful, even pulls from first to last

Smooth flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Rocket Blast Champagne Drip is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
